notes: A ten-class multinomial logistic model is trained on 75% of the real digit images. The nine small panels show classes 0–8 on one probability scale; the RGB mixture includes all ten probabilities. Grid points are lifted from the two-PC plane back to 64 pixel coordinates before prediction. Dots are held-out images projected onto these axes and colored by their true class. Their full-space predictions need not coincide with the affine slice at the projected locations. PCA is fit on training data only.
